description: Influenced heavily by David Bowie and Roxy Music, the New Romantics embraced androgyny, theatricality, and a DIY approach to glamour. The aesthetic was eclectic, blending historical costumes with futuristic elements. The scene was closely tied to the rise of synth-pop, and its visual extravagance was perfectly suited for the nascent medium of the music video, which helped propel associated bands like Duran Duran, Spandau Ballet, and Visage to international fame via MTV.
